sources.title: EXPLAINER: Putin Wanted to Sideline Europe. He May Have Made It Stronger

en.title: Kyiv Post: Putin's sidelining attempt may have strengthened European unity ahead of Trump summit
en.dek: Russia's strategy to use Trump to pressure Ukraine instead pushed Europe to take greater responsibility for Kyiv's defense.
facts: Kyiv Post reports Russia attempted to use Trump to pressure Ukraine into concessions.
European governments now supply most of Ukraine's aid, gaining influence over peace negotiations.
Kremlin adviser Yuri Ushakov said Europe must show 'constructive, substantive contribution' before joining talks.
Steve Witkoff, Trump's envoy, previously told reporters Europeans would join at the next meeting.
Moscow objects to Europe's weapons, money, sanctions and plans to send troops to Ukraine after ceasefire.
body: Kyiv Post reports that Russia attempted to use Donald Trump to pressure Ukraine into concessions, but the strategy backfired. European governments have instead taken greater responsibility for Kyiv's defense, now supplying most of the money and weapons that keep Ukraine fighting. This shift has frustrated Moscow's efforts to dictate a settlement, as Russia now must deal with a stronger European position.

Kremlin foreign policy adviser Yuri Ushakov stated that Russia had not agreed to European participation in the next round of talks, despite earlier comments from Trump envoy Steve Witkoff that 'the Europeans will join at the next meeting.' Ushakov insisted 'a great deal would have to be done first,' requiring Europe to show what constructive contribution it can make. On Thursday, Ushakov said Europe's actions pointed to war, while Moscow objects to Europe's weapons, money, sanctions and plans to send troops to Ukraine after a ceasefire.

The strategy has already delivered an unintended consequence: Washington has agreed to discuss Europe's security architecture with Russia, opening the door to demands that previous American administrations rejected. Moscow's calculation was straightforward — Donald Trump wanted a deal, and Putin saw an opportunity to exploit an accommodating American president. However, the flaw in Moscow's calculation was that Trump cut new US aid to Ukraine and told Europeans to take responsibility for their own security, resulting in Washington losing much of its influence over both Ukraine and Europe.
en.context: Kyiv Post reports that Russia relied on the United States to force Ukraine to give way, but instead helped turn Europe into a power it now has to deal with. Other topics of interest include Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin meeting ahead of a historic Trump trilateral summit, raising concerns about Ukraine's future being discussed without Kyiv or Europe.

zh.title: 普京试图边缘化的行动可能在特朗普峰会前加强了欧洲团结
zh.dek: 俄罗斯利用特朗普对乌克兰施压的策略，反而促使欧洲承担起基辅防御的更大责任
facts: 基里夫邮报报道俄罗斯试图利用特朗普施压乌克兰让步
欧洲政府现在提供乌克兰大部分援助，在和平谈判中获得影响力
克里姆林宫顾问尤里·乌沙科夫表示，欧洲在加入谈判前必须展现“建设性、实质性贡献”
特朗普特使斯蒂夫·威特科夫此前告诉记者，欧洲将在下次会议上加入
莫斯科反对欧洲的武器、资金、制裁以及战后派遣部队进入乌克兰的计划
body: 基里夫新闻报道称，俄罗斯试图利用唐纳德·特朗普对乌克兰施压，要求其让步，但该策略适得其反。欧洲政府反而加大了对基辅防御的责任，现在提供了大部分维持乌克兰作战的资金和武器。这种转变挫败了莫斯科制定安排的努力，因为俄罗斯现在必须面对更强势的欧洲立场。
克里姆林宫外交顾问尤里·乌沙科夫表示，俄罗斯并未同意在下一轮谈判中让欧洲参与，尽管特朗普特使斯蒂夫·威特科夫早些时候曾表示“欧洲人将在下次会议上加入”。乌沙科夫坚持称“必须先做很多工作”，要求欧洲展示其能作出的建设性贡献。周四，乌沙科夫指出欧洲的行动指向战争，而莫斯科则反对欧洲的武器、资金、制裁以及在停火后向乌克兰派遣部队的计划。
这项策略已产生意想不到的后果：华盛顿同意与俄罗斯讨论欧洲安全架构，这为此前美国历届政府拒绝的要求打开了大门。莫斯科的计算很简单——特朗普想要达成协议，普京看到了一个利用一位愿意妥协的美国总统的机会。然而，莫斯科计算中的缺陷在于，特朗普削减了对乌克兰的新援助，并告知欧洲人要为自己的安全负责，结果华盛顿对乌克兰和欧洲的影响力大幅丧失。
zh.context: 基里夫邮报报道称，俄罗斯依赖美国迫使乌克兰让步，但结果却帮助欧洲成为其不得不面对的势力。其他引人关注的议题包括习近平和弗拉基米尔·普京在历史性特朗普三边峰会前会晤，这引发了关于乌克兰未来在未经基辅或欧洲参与的情况下被讨论的担忧。
